sloka: नाना देशात् अनुप्राप्ताः पुरुषाः स्त्री गणाः तथा ।अन्न पानैः सुविहिताः तस्मिन् यज्ञे महात्मनः ॥१-१४-१६॥
transliteration: nānā deśāt anuprāptāḥ puruṣāḥ strī gaṇāḥ tathā ।anna pānaiḥ suvihitāḥ tasmin yajñe mahātmanaḥ ॥1-14-16॥

translations.english: While brahmins were being served with food by welldressed men, some others wearing pendents studded with shining jewels assisted them.
